rationale: Strategy Research Task AA. Reserves Binance spot BTCUSDT's earliest available 1d history -- the only window in this project's history, on any exchange, that no trial has ever accessed -- as a second, independent holdout for the SAME strategy_id ('daily-tsmom-ensemble') sr-u/sr-v already spent one holdout access on. See configs/research/preregistrations/daily-tsmom-ensemble-binance-virgin-holdout.json for the registration this config supports, and .planning/sr-aa-binance-virgin-window-registration.md for full reasoning. SOURCE AND VERIFICATION: Binance spot BTCUSDT/1d, fetched via python/data/binance_klines.py and cached under storage_symbol 'BINANCE:BTCUSDT' by python/data/backfill_binance.py (Strategy Research Task Z, .planning/sr-z-binance-data-research.md, which first backfilled and gap-verified the full 2017-08-17..2026-08-04 series). This task (sr-aa) re-ran that same backfill for real against the live production Binance endpoint on 2026-08-05, scoped to exactly this holdout's own range, and independently re-verified it directly against python/data/store.py's fetch_klines/find_missing_ranges (not estimated, not reused from sr-z's own prior report): 1,366 rows for the half-open range [1502928000000, 1620950400000), earliest bar 2017-08-17T00:00:00Z, latest bar 2021-05-13T00:00:00Z (one day before the exclusive cutoff, as expected), every open_time_ms on the 86,400,000ms UTC-midnight grid (zero off-grid rows), find_missing_ranges returns [] over the full span (zero gaps), and the set of consecutive-row time deltas is the single value {86400000} (a third, independent confirmation of zero gaps: no skipped day and no duplicate). 1,366 matches the expected half-open bar count for this range exactly (arithmetic, not an estimate). CUTOFF CHOICE, justified explicitly rather than assumed: 1620950400000 (2021-05-14T00:00:00Z) is the EXACT SAME cutoff instant configs/research/holdout_1d.json already uses for BingX's own 1d holdout -- not a coincidence, and not chosen freshly for this config. That instant is the earliest date ANY trial in this project's history, on ANY exchange or data source, has ever accessed: BingX's own 1d retention begins there (holdout_1d.json's own committed rationale), sr-v's holdout confirmation run scored exactly [1620950400000, 1714089600000), and Strategy Research Task Z's own cross-exchange correlation and regime analysis of Binance data -- the only prior Binance-data-touching work in this project -- computed its correlation figure over the OVERLAP window with BingX, which is 2021-05-14 onward, and its coarse/fine regime detection-floor tables, which report on calendar spans and day-counts, never per-bar price levels. Reusing this exact instant means the boundary is a historical fact about where this project's own data access begins, not a new judgment call open to search-based tuning. Choosing any earlier instant would be impossible (no Binance data exists before 2017-08-17, the real listing date); choosing any later instant would needlessly shrink the one genuinely virgin span this project has left. HOLDOUT: 1,366 daily bars, 2017-08-17 through 2021-05-13 inclusive (~3.74 years) -- holdout_side='before' means the reserved data is the EARLIEST slice, mirroring holdout_1d.json's own inverted convention and for the identical reason: CLAUDE.md defines a holdout by what has been done to the data, not by its calendar position, and here (as there) the property of 'never having informed a decision' holds for the early window, not a trailing one. RESEARCH SIDE OF THIS CONFIG, DISCLOSED RATHER THAN LEFT IMPLICIT: this config's own 'research' side (Binance data at/after the 2021-05-14 cutoff) is NOT virgin and must never be treated as such -- Strategy Research Task Z already read real Binance rows in that exact span for its cross-exchange correlation computation (1,909 common days, 2021-05-14 through 2026-08-04), and that same calendar span is also where BingX's own already-extensively-searched research data lives. This config exists to gate the EARLY (holdout) side only; nothing in this project currently calls load_research_klines against this config, and nothing should, without first re-confirming that side's own touched status has not changed. A REAL, DISCLOSED CAVEAT ON 'VIRGIN', NAMED HONESTLY RATHER THAN GLOSSED OVER: Strategy Research Task Z's own early-era (2017-2019) DATA-QUALITY check (zero-range/zero-volume/stale-quote checks, and a cross-reference of real OHLC prints against widely-known historical BTC price levels: the 2017-12-17 ATH high, the 2018-12-15 bear-bottom low, the 2021-11-10 ATH high, the 2022-11-21 cycle-bottom low) DID read real price levels from inside this exact holdout span, and those four price figures are committed in plain text in .planning/sr-z-binance-data-research.md. This is a real prior access to raw price LEVELS in this window, not a hypothetical concern -- named explicitly rather than asserted away. It is judged not to compromise this holdout for THIS hypothesis specifically because: (a) it was a data-integrity check (gap/stale-quote/plausibility verification), never a strategy-selection or hypothesis-forming pass -- no signal, parameter, threshold, or trading decision was chosen or adjusted based on it; (b) the daily-tsmom-ensemble strategy this holdout supports is zero-fitted-parameter and literature-specified (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012's own canonical lookback set), with nothing in its design that could have been tuned to those four spot-price levels even in principle; and (c) the four disclosed price levels are themselves independently, publicly well-known historical facts about BTC (matched in the sr-z report against CoinDesk/Forbes-cited figures) -- knowing them adds no information about this window's own SIGN pattern of 21/63/126/252-trading-day returns, which is what the registered signal actually depends on. This caveat is recorded here so a future reader does not encounter a stronger 'zero exposure' claim than is actually true.
notes: This is the SECOND holdout config this project has defined for the daily-tsmom-ensemble strategy_id (the first is configs/research/holdout_1d.json, BingX-sourced, spent by sr-v on 2026-07-30, INCONCLUSIVE). research.holdout.load_holdout_klines's single-access enforcement keys on strategy_id alone, not on which holdout_config_path is passed -- so a real execution against THIS config will require a force_reclaim_reason. See the pre-registration's own stopping_rule and notes for that reason, pre-committed before any execution.
